content: Rahul Jain contacted insurance agent Ramesh Tiwari regarding a failed payment transaction of ₹12,450 for his car insurance policy (AU-45219). Ramesh confirmed the portal still shows 'Expired' due to the pending payment and agreed to generate and send a fresh secure payment link via email and WhatsApp. Once paid, the policy status will automatically update to 'Active' with a renewal date until 04/10/2027.

action_items: Ramesh to send a new secure payment link to customer's email and WhatsApp
Rahul to complete the payment using the new link
